ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale genomes and population data reveal lineage-specific evolutionary history
ranked.summary: Assembly-level resources now span ticks, warblers, elephants and papillomaviruses, enabling direct cross-lineage comparison of genome content.

ranked.headline: Statistical methods resolve cell colocalization and niches in spatial omics
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell measurements are increasingly analysed with explicit inferential frameworks, emphasising significance testing and method comparison.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict immune recognition and guide de novo antibody and peptide design
ranked.summary: Training data scale and generative or active-learning loops now tie model predictions directly to experimental validation.

ranked.headline: Adapting biomedical imaging models with controls, priors, and transcriptomic distillation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address domain shift and cohort heterogeneity in biomedical imaging through controls, priors, and transcriptomic supervision.

ranked.headline: Structure-based inference of protein interactions at residue and network scale
ranked.summary: AlphaFold-era structural models now enable proteome-wide interaction screening, from Drosophila interactomes to cryptic site prediction.

ranked.headline: Cross-species genomics reveals architecture, ancestry and regulatory divergence
ranked.summary: Hi-C across 1,025 species and graph-based deep learning on crop transcriptomic, proteomic and metabolic layers now enable comparative analysis at scale.

ranked.headline: Non-genetic B cell state stability speeds antibody affinity maturation
ranked.summary: Mechanistic germinal center models and lineage-explicit simulators now provide ground truth for testing how antibody populations evolve.

ranked.headline: Sequence and transcript inference extends from model organisms to microbial communities
ranked.summary: Recent studies apply sequence and transcript inference to non-model organisms and microbial communities, where analytical choices limit reliability.

ranked.headline: Inferring stochastic dynamics and rates from single-cell and stochastic-model data
ranked.summary: Time-resolved single-cell data and explicit stochastic models now allow direct estimation of division rates, diffusion, and velocity dynamics per cell.

ranked.headline: Variant effect predictors and mechanistic models extend beyond missense interpretation
ranked.summary: Calibrated clinical evidence levels for in-frame indels and tissue-specific dosage metrics for structural variants are now being reported.

ranked.headline: Learned encoders from sequences, spectra and networks drive biomolecular prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply contrastive, multimodal and diffusion-based encoders to RNA, protein, gene, metabolite and drug prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Molecular ML models tested for what their feature representations actually encode
ranked.summary: Physics- and chemistry-based features, embeddings, and benchmark designs are now probed directly against model performance and generalization limits.

ranked.headline: Mapping trait heritability and aging variation onto individual cells and genes
ranked.summary: Single-cell atlases now let trait heritability and age-linked expression variability be resolved to cell states and individual genes.

ranked.headline: Models couple omics, imaging and clinical data for cancer biomarkers and prognosis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark and build models that fuse omics, imaging, cfDNA and clinical modalities within single frameworks.

ranked.headline: Simulation with experimental restraints maps amyloid aggregation-prone states
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers couple MD and coarse-grained simulation with NMR restraints or sequence predictors to probe aggregation-prone conformers.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking generalist cell segmenters across microscopy and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Generalist segmentation models are now benchmarked on live microscopy, CODEX and Xenium data, with ground-truth-free metrics added for cross-tissue comparison.

ranked.headline: Spatial models link dendritic cell arrangement and viral spread to immune activation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model couple spatial simulation with immune activation and viral dynamics, linking local structure to response outcomes.

ranked.headline: Structure-based modeling guides prioritization of pathways, binders, and fragment poses
ranked.summary: Structure models are now applied across genome mining, binder filtering, and fragment datasets to narrow candidates before experiments.

ranked.headline: Generative models steer structural ensembles and sequence design via latent control
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair generative models with latent steering, search over predictors, and ensemble sampling for protein and RNA design.

ranked.headline: Automated pipelines for single-cell transcriptomics, proteomics and imaging data
ranked.summary: Automated workflows now standardise QC, annotation and quantification across single-cell transcriptomic, proteomic and imaging datasets.

ranked.headline: Single-cell representations integrate proteomic, transcriptomic and spatial modalities
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers extend single-cell embeddings to multi-omic, proteomic and spatial settings with explicit claims of transferability across…

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose ambiguity and metric limits in RNA sequencing inference tools
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks show that accuracy claims for transcriptome inference depend on how uncertainty, error and metric choice are handled.

ranked.headline: Foundation models for biological sequences and cells tested against simple baselines
ranked.summary: Reported gains from pretrained genomic and single-cell models are being re-examined through standardized benchmarks and simple reference baselines.

ranked.headline: Consistency and priors as proxies for biomolecular structural plausibility
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs heterogeneous priors with structural consistency checks across fold accuracy, RNA model scoring, and nucleic acid binding.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map dynamic states governing calmodulin, Rac2, and BRAF function
ranked.summary: Dynamics-aware simulation now informs variant design, mutant state trapping, and free-energy mapping of autoinhibited kinase conformations.

ranked.headline: Genomic context shapes how regulatory elements bind, evolve and regulate expression
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test how sequence, conservation, network topology and cell type context shape regulatory binding and expression.

ranked.headline: Software tools speed up or package established genomic analyses for reproducible use
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair large speedups over established tools with scripted or GUI front ends for genomic, epigenomic, and cytometry analysis.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking docking, co-folding, and ML models across screening and bioactivity data
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks test Boltz-2 co-folding and docking on DNA-encoded libraries, ultralarge screening hit lists, and kinase bioactivity splits.

ranked.headline: Integrated multi-algorithm ortholog prediction extends across organisms and metagenomes
ranked.summary: Recent updates consolidate ortholog assignment into multi-algorithm frameworks spanning model organisms and metagenomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Constrained and generative models estimate metabolic fluxes and kinetic parameters
ranked.summary: Recent studies make thermodynamic feasibility and dynamical targets outputs of constrained or latent metabolic representations.

ranked.headline: Generative design balancing competing in silico objectives across molecules and fragments
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs generative models with docking, RL, and QUBO optimization to balance competing in silico design objectives.

ranked.headline: Minimal models separate adhesion limits from numerical and noise artifacts in migration
ranked.summary: Recent minimal models of leader-follower, Voronoi, Rho GTPase, and border cell migration probe which constraints are genuine versus artifactual.

ranked.headline: Optimal transport models single-cell CAR responses; spatial distances pair BCR chains
ranked.summary: Recent single-cell tools predict perturbation responses and receptor pairing from expression and spatial data rather than direct measurement alone.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking proteomics software workflows across sample types and acquisition modes
ranked.summary: Public proteomics reuse depends on analysis software choice and file-level metadata capture, which recent benchmarks and tools now address directly.

ranked.headline: Variant calling beyond the reference: copy number, sequencing artifacts, signed LD
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study address KIR copy number, the origins of signed LD, and Illumina dye-chemistry artifacts in somatic calling.

ranked.headline: Perturbation screens and network models nominate therapeutic targets across diseases
ranked.summary: Network-based and multimodal perturbation platforms now pair large intervention spaces with disease-relevant readouts in metabolic and neuronal contexts.

ranked.headline: Theoretical models of cellular organization, fate fixation and tumor dormancy dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalize how noise, energy gradients, and microenvironment feedback generate organized cellular states, all still purely theoretical.

ranked.headline: Deep models link single-cell transcriptomes to donor phenotypes and cross-species cell…
ranked.summary: Harmonized single-cell atlases and donor-aware generative models now enable phenotype-resolved and cross-species inference from transcriptomes.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for microbiome composition, taxonomy, and function inference
ranked.summary: Open-source workflows and plugins now infer microbial function and networks directly from 16S rRNA k-mers, compositional data, and shotgun metagenomes.

ranked.headline: Gapless and graph-based reference assemblies built from long-read and Hi-C sequencing
ranked.summary: Long-read and Hi-C data now support gapless telomere-to-telomere chromosome assemblies and chromosome-level pangenome graphs.
